evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep moved directly into logistics and pricing without raising the two-concern opening.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were probed by the rep using the two-concerns question.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never addressed. Rep quoted Friday at $218/hr without discussing day-of-week pricing or flexibility.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Not present. Rep scheduled the move and confirmed details without any explicit rate-lock promise or clear close ('Would you like our help with your move?'). Rep said: 'Alright, well, I'll get this scheduled for you right away for Friday... I'll get this scheduled and sent over the confirmation email.'

top_strength: Jules recovered smoothly from a customer database lookup confusion, clarified the pickup and delivery addresses, and gathered enough detail about the job (queen bed, storage unit dimensions, floor location, elevator protection needs) to price accurately.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire discovery process — no two-concerns question, no probing for concerns, no Two Promises about reliability or damage coverage, no rate lock, and no explicit ask for the business; the booking happened by default with no clear commitment step, which leaves the customer with no confidence anchor and the company exposed to cancellation.
